# Junior Software Engineer, Field Service Platform — Columbus, OH (hybrid), full-time

Join the Field Service Platform team at Orvanta Digital.
Responsibilities: build and test backend features for FieldLink work orders; write SQL against our PostgreSQL databases; contribute to our shared CI pipeline; document your changes for the teams in Columbus and Lyon.
Required: Python or Java; SQL; Git and code review; automated testing.
Preferred: Azure; French or another second language.
